def array_manip(array):
    result = []
    for i in range(len(array) - 1, -1, -1):
        found = True
        for j in range(i + 1, len(array)):
            if array[j] > array[i]:
                result.append(array[j])
                found = True
                break
        if not found:
            result.append(-1)
    return result[::-1]
